emphasis.emphasis: Students will complete the following questions to practice the skills they have learned in this lesson.

list.item: Which of the following points is the vertex of the quadratic function \(f(x)=x^2+8x+22\)?
Write the function in standard form. Use the "^" symbol to enter an exponent.
Write the function from question 2 in vertex form. Use the "^" symbol to enter an exponent.

section.para: For questions 5 - 6, write an equation in vertex form of the quadratic function that has a vertex at \((-4, 1)\) and also goes through the point \((6, -1)\).

list.item: Find the value of \(a\) for vertex form in simplest form.
Write the equation in vertex form. Use the "^" symbol to enter an exponent.

section.para: For questions 7 and 8, write an equation in vertex form of the quadratic function that has a vertex at \((-2, -3)\) and also goes through the point \((4, 2)\).

list.item: Find the value of \(a\) for vertex form in simplest form.
Write the equation in vertex form. Use the "^" symbol to enter an exponent.

section.para: For questions 9 - 10, use the function \(f(x)=x^2\) that is shifted to create the function \(g(x)\) that has a vertex at \((-4, 6)\).

list.item: Write \(g(x)\) in vertex form. Use the "^" symbol to enter an exponent.

section.para:
Substitute the vertex in for \((h, k)\)
\(g(x)=(x-(-4))^2+6\)
\(g(x)=(x+4)^2+6\)

list.item: Write \(g(x)\) in standard form. Use the "^" symbol to enter an exponent.
